thi-ap11:1.1: Sumedhavaggo paṭhamo. VAGGO II [11. Ekūposathikā.] NagareBandhumatiyā Bandhumā nāma khattiyo / divase puṇṇamāyaṃ so upapajji uposathaṃ. // //
thi-ap11:2.1: Ahaṃtena samayena kumbhadāsī ahuṃ tahiṃ / disvā sarājikaṃ senaṃ evāhaṃ cintayiṃ tadā: // //
thi-ap11:3.1: Rājāpi rajjaṃ chaḍḍetvā upapajji uposathaṃ / saphalaṃ nūna taṃ kammaṃ janakāyo pamodito. // //
thi-ap11:4.1: Yonisopaccavekkhitvā duggaccañ ca daḷiddataṃ / manasaṃ sampahaṃsetvā upapajjiṃ uposathaṃ. // //
thi-ap11:5.1: Ahaṃuposathaṃ katvā sammāsambuddhasāsane / tena kammena sukatena Tāvatiṃsaṃ agacch' ahaṃ. // //
thi-ap11:6.1: Tatthame sukataṃ vyamhaṃ ubbhaṃ yojanam uggataṃ / kūṭāgāravarūpetaṃ mahāsayanabhūsitaṃ. // //
thi-ap11:7.1: Accharāsatasahassā upatiṭṭhanti maṃ sadā / aññe deve atikkamma atirocāmi sabbadā. // //
thi-ap11:8.1: Catusaṭṭhidevarājānaṃ mahesittam akārayiṃ / tesaṭṭhi cakkavattīnaṃ mahesittam akārayiṃ. // //
thi-ap11:9.1: Suvaṇṇavaṇṇāhutvāna bhavesu saṃsarām' ahaṃ / sabbattha pavarā homi; uposathass' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
thi-ap11:10.1: Hatthiyānaṃassayānaṃ rathayānañ ca kevalaṃ / labhāmi sabbam etam hi uposathass' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
thi-ap11:11.1: Sovaṇṇamayaṃrūpimayaṃ atho pi phalikāmayaṃ / lohitaṅkamayañ c' eva sabbaṃ paṭilabhām' ahaṃ. // //
thi-ap11:12.1: Koseyyakambalīyānikhomakappāsikāni ca / mahagghāni ca vatthāni sabbaṃ paṭilabhām' ahaṃ. // //
thi-ap11:13.1: Annaṃpānaṃ khādaniyaṃ vatthasenāsanāni ca / sabbam etaṃ paṭilabhe; uposathass' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
thi-ap11:14.1: Varagandhañca mālañ ca cuṇṇakañ ca vilepanaṃ / sabbam etaṃ paṭilabhe, uposathass' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
thi-ap11:15.1: Kūṭāgārañca pāsādaṃ maṇḍapaṃ hammiyaṃ guhaṃ / sabbam etaṃ paṭilabhe, uposathass' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
thi-ap11:16.1: Jātiyāsattavass āhaṃ pabbajiṃ anagāriyaṃ / aṭṭhamāse asampatte arahattaṃ apāpuṇiṃ. // //
thi-ap11:17.1: Kilesā. . . pe . . . pe . . . pe . . . / sabbāsavā parikkhīṇā n' atthi dāni punabbhavo. // //
thi-ap11:18.1: Ekanavuteito kappe yaṃ kammam akariṃ tadā / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi uposathass' idaṃ phalaṃ.
thi-ap11:22.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ Ekūposathikā bhikkhunī i. g. a-ti.
